question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is option 2) i.e. '**recollect**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: Word Meaning guess an estimate or conclusion based on little or no information. (अनुमान) recollect remember; recall. (स्मरण करना) imagine form a mental image or concept of something. (कल्पना करना) estimate roughly calculate or judge the value, number, quantity, or extent of. (अनुमान लगाना) • Let's look at the sentence: "He sat on his stool and shut his eyes to ____________ what work he had for the day..." • **"Recollect"** means to remember something by making an effort to bring it back to one's mind. In the context of the passage, Swaminathan was trying **to remember** what work he had for the day by shutting his eyes and making an effort to remember. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "recollect" to make the sentence meaningfully correct. • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. ​ Complete passage:__ Swaminathan had a table on which all his things, his coat, cap, slate, ink-bottle, and books, were thrown in a confused (1) heap. He sat on his stool and shut his eyes to (2) recollect what work he had for the day: first of course there was Arithmetic – those five (3) puzzles in Profit and Loss; then there was English – he had to copy down a page from his English lesson and write dictionary meanings of (4) difficult words; and then there was Geography. And only two hours before him to do all this heap of work and get (5) ready for school. 192:T208d,
